object.attr: derived: MELLON-VER-SRS-60 covers only a version that resolves to no commit, and git picks one of two clashing names without a warning. Found by the Compare failure analysis on 2026-11-06 (CF3).
object.description: If a version given to the MCP server's compare tool resolves to more than one commit, the MCP server should return an error naming the version.
